doc.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
doc.interviewee: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams

chapter: Williams on guitar technique and prison
title: Williams's vision while on guard post at the prison
summary: Williams tells how, while on guard duty, something touched his shoulder and told him he would be home for Christmas; he prayed and felt relieved.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: So, I would tell them all the time. I said, I'm a little bit of fighting going on. They told me, no, you can't do that. You got to run away. We put the dogs in behind you. I said, no, there won't be no dogs. I said, when I leave here, I said, there's somebody coming here and get me. So, I was on the post. They gave me a gun, put my guard clothes on me. And around. So, I sat up there on the post. No, no, no, no. I never could nobody get in that post before I had it locked up. And I know it's a guard. But the shore, you got that wind blowing out there. I was sitting there, holding my gun across my lap. And something come to me and patting me on my shoulder.
That's the old woman's drink. That's not a house, huh? That's too much for me.
The woman told me, don't worry. You'll be at home with your family. Christmas.

I jumped. Mm-hmm. And I stood up and I looked. I didn't see nobody. So, I sat back down. Something come to him again. Pat him on my shoulder. I said, don't worry. Get up and pray. I got up. Looked all the way around again. So, okay, I couldn't close my eyes because I have to watch for the line walker. He got a light one. He flashed you. He got to flash him back.
I got on my knees. But I kept my eyes out at that runner so I could see if he's coming around the corner. So if he flashed me, I could flash him back. I got down there and prayed. Prayed.
And after praying, about five minutes after I got off my knees, well, the man did come around the corner. And he flashed me and I flashed him back.
But it left me feeling good. Mm-hmm. Good.
